raw_text: The Rise of AI News Anchors in State-Backed Disinformation. A network of YouTube channels has been using AI-generated news presenters created with tools like HeyGen to broadcast fabricated anti-India news content targeting South Asian and global audiences. Rest of World's investigation traced the hosting infrastructure to servers in Islamabad and Shenzhen. The synthetic anchors deliver professional-looking news bulletins containing entirely false narratives about India's economic and political situation.
clean_text: Rest of World investigation on AI news anchor disinformation network targeting India. HeyGen-style presenters deliver fabricated content. Infrastructure traced to Islamabad and Shenzhen servers.
